title: Import the rn-forge Bootstrap theme into an Angular application

project.description: Angular application project whose stylesheet imports the theme.
project.x-prompt: Which Angular application should import the theme?

stylesheet.description: Workspace-relative path of the SCSS stylesheet to patch. Defaults to the build target's first SCSS style, else src/styles.scss.

force.description: Replace the content of the rn-forge markers with the plain theme import.
